items.text: There is more to reality than the physical world we can observe.
All that exists is ultimately physical matter and energy.
Nonphysical aspects of reality are as real as physical ones.
Everything that happens can, in principle, be explained by physical processes.
Consciousness is not fully reducible to physical processes.
There is nothing beyond the material universe.
Reality includes spiritual or nonmaterial dimensions.
Physical laws are sufficient to explain all phenomena.
